You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.

Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ A woman, maybe 20s catches you eyeing the bark plates — claw-scored, vine-laced. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They talk you through it — wide strips dried flat, laced overlapping like shingles, snug but not tight. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.

sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 2). Honey is antibacterial. Sugar packs wounds. Yarrow stops bleeding. The old ways work.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
📖 LEARNED: Anatomy (Level 2). Pressure points: brachial, femoral, carotid. You can stop bleeding or drop someone with a thumb.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Surgical Grace! You heal like a surgeon with infinite tools. Critical heals. (Your knowledge of Anatomy amplifies your field_medicine.)
📖 LEARNED: Grave Robber (Level 2). The dead don't mind. Much.
📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 4 skills from your past — check your Journal.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Landon Romero. Mortician. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Photo album, Dispatcher's headset, Brass Locket, Tasting Spoon, Oath Ring. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Don't bother picking around the tents. Walk out. The land feeds people who go looking."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
You tell the others you're heading out. Someone nods. "Come back before dark."
